verdict.rationale: GlitchTip's pricing page documents a monthly spend cap on on-demand billing, so overage from an error spike stays bounded. Plans also carry event allowances, such as 1,000 events per month on the Free plan. There is no evidence of per-project event quota caps. SDK-side sampling (tracesSampleRate) is a client setting for transactions, not a product quota control, so it earns no credit. Missing for 10: per-project event quota caps, documentation of what happens to events once the spend cap is hit, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the spend cap.

support.subject: As an engineering leader, I can cap event quotas per project and set spend limits so an error storm burns a predictable budget, never a surprise invoice

citations.quote: Turn on on-demand billing and set a monthly spend cap. When a spike pushes you past your plan, we keep collecting events and bill only for the extra.
Our Free plan is free forever with up to 1,000 events per month.
